# Tecumseh Heating & Cooling

> From its base in Tecumseh, Essex County, Tecumseh Heating & Cooling serves homeowners with residential HVAC work: emergency furnace repair, AC tune-ups and replacements, ductless mini-splits, cold-climate heat pumps, gas fireplaces, thermostats, and duct cleaning.

Phone: (548) 457-1225  |  Email: contact@tecumsehheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://tecumsehheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Tecumseh, Windsor, LaSalle, Amherstburg, Leamington, Lakeshore, Belle River, Essex
